state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / population-snapshots / context.RequestId; retry compares exact content/lineage/actor; chunk keys deterministic; physical expected position. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / population-snapshots / SnapshotId, with exact immutable root/amendment lineage and canonical population identity. Storage chunk identities remain deterministic storage values, separate from the business snapshot.
owners.invariant: Freeze exactly one canonical immutable population identity, optionally a manifest over ordered immutable chunk identities; amendments have separate roots.
owners.boundaryRationale: Rows may live outside root because immutable hashes/manifests bind exact order/count; root commit makes snapshot visible only after chunks exist. Current implementation has retry-based recovery, not a recovery reactor.

owners.invariant: Permanent practice binding for subjectKind=staff or canonical_user; acquire both user and staff subjects in canonical stream-key order. No release/revoke command exists.
owners.mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.

owners.invariant: Permanent binding of signed assertion identity to digest, designation, canonical user and duty scope; claim identity cannot be recycled.
owners.mustPreserve: Exact predecessor, monotonically increasing authority revision, stable signed subject, valid staff source proof.

owners.invariant: Compact latest-assessment pointer, decision admission/seal generation, latest management decision and permanent approved Type I entry pointer. Serialize latest-assessment adoption with decision append; keep full assessment/decision content in immutable manifests. Run admission precedes child computation and reserves exactly one pending latest-adoption generation.
owners.mustPreserve: No projected latest assessment or gap list can authorize entry; all exceptions/required plans acknowledged.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / program-rollovers / rolloverId; proposal content compare; approval per version no-op; revision command checks before comparison; exact successor receipt compares timestamp. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / program-rollovers / RolloverId, with exact source program/version and successor proof. RolloverId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId.
owners.invariant: One exact carry-forward proposal version requires independent approval and an atomic execution claim before successor writes; the claim pins that version against revision, and exact successor completion is recorded only in recoverable private process state.
owners.boundaryRationale: ProgramRollover owns proposal, independent approval, and one atomic version-pinning execution claim/fence because the claim closes the revise-versus-execute race. Recoverable private ProgramRolloverExecutionProcess owns progress and verified successor receipts. A person authors the complete successor TypeIIPlan under its independent owner lifecycle. Prior proposal history and successor acknowledgements are not business aggregate state.

owners.invariant: One provider content, version and retirement lifecycle.
owners.mustPreserve: Exact creation identity and expected provider revision; active normalized name unique within tenant.

owners.invariant: One current assurance gap with exact source-version and closure lineage.
owners.mustPreserve: Risk adoption cannot close a gap or occur after closure; each review binds same provider/current report.

owners.invariant: Evidence report for one provider and exact provider revision.
owners.mustPreserve: Risk adoption cannot close a gap or occur after closure; each review binds same provider/current report.
